No roller-screw- or humanoid-specific revenue is broken out; this is a diversified $5.23bn photonics/precision-motion name (FY2025 revenue $0.98bn), not a concentrated read.

theme_revenue_exposure.basis: No humanoid-actuator- or sensor-specific revenue share is disclosed for Novanta; the ATI Industrial Automation force/torque-sensor line sits inside the broader Precision Motion segment and is not broken out separately in SEC companyfacts.

revenue_latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NOVT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_latest_fy.basis: Revenues for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL companyfacts for CIK 1076930 (Novanta Inc, Nasdaq: NOVT).

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NOVT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (980600000/860903000)**(1/3)-1 from the companyfacts revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NOVT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: Operating income 94012000 divided by revenue 980600000, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NOVT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 64056000 less capital expenditure 15627000, divided by revenue 980600000, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NOVT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 64056000 divided by net income 53829000, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/NOVT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -530493000 (total debt 188157000 as of 2026-07-03 less cash 718650000 as of 2026-07-03) divided by an EBITDA proxy 155944000 (operating income 94012000 plus depreciation 61932000, both for the period ended 2025-12-31), from companyfacts.

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NOVT.json quality, computed over SEC EDGAR companyfacts
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 6 (state MIDDLING) computed over companyfacts statements in data/market/NOVT.json quality.piotroski; 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NOVT.json quality, computed over SEC EDGAR companyfacts
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.251 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over sec-companyfacts statements in data/market/NOVT.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

market_cap.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NOVT.json quality, computed over SEC EDGAR companyfacts
market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 5227941760.0 computed in data/market/NOVT.json quality.derived.market_cap from SEC companyfacts share count 35671000 (as of 2025-12-31) times the repo's own market-plane close of 146.56 (yfinance, 2026-09-11).

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NOVT.json quality, computed over SEC EDGAR companyfacts
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 5227941760.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 980600000.

implied_fcf_cagr.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/NOVT.json quality, computed over SEC EDGAR companyfacts
implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 48429000.0, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over companyfacts statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.
